films.title: Phaedra
films.description: Dassin and Melina Mercouri update the stepmother's desire to a modern Greek shipping dynasty — Phaedra's forbidden love for her husband's son.

music.title: Hippolyte et Aricie
music.description: Rameau's first opera stages Phaedra's passion and Theseus' curse — the stepmother's confession that destroys Hippolytus.

popCulture.title: Phèdre
popCulture.creator: Jean Racine
popCulture.description: Racine's tragedy is the French Phaedra: guilt, desire and the confession that kills, still the standard modern stage face of the myth.
